card.name: Oncology antibody label text positions
card.fires_on: Spaces and small pieces right after or inside oncology biologic brand names (TECENTRIQ, IMFINZI, ENHERTU) in prescribing information. Also fires on 'to' after 'hypersensitivity' and on '-L' in PD-L1.

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: Partway through the name TECENTRIQ, or the space right after a brand name like ENHERTU.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space before a table number or dose number in dosing sections.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity 'to'
modes.description: The word 'to' after known hypersensitivity in contraindications.
